recentItems.title: SURYAA: Ant Se Aarambh Tak - Official Teaser | Sunny Deol, Ravi Kishan | M Padmakumar| 20th Nov 2026
recentItems.description:
THEY THOUGHT IT WAS HIS END.
FOR SURYAA, IT WAS ONLY THE BEGINNING. 🔥

On Sunny Deol’s birthday, witness him in a never-seen-before avatar.  Scarred by his past, driven by the truth, and ready to take on a system built to bury it.

Kamal Mukut's #SURYAA अंत से आरंभ तक
IN CINEMAS 20th November 2026.
#HappyBirthdaySunnyDeol
